budgetAnalysis.sequencing: Evaluate: acquisition helper requests 1-4; exactly one worker; publication inspection helper requests 5-9. Verify-decision: four helper requests and one worker. Helpers and worker do not overlap.
budgetAnalysis.arithmetic: 20000 + 10000 = 30000 leaves zero separately reserved time for all other work if both maxima are consumed. Independent maxima are ceilings, not reservations or simultaneous entitlements.
budgetAnalysis.coherence: CLI admission remains coherent because the worker and every helper are clipped to the same absolute 30000ms deadline. Successful completion at each component maximum is not promised.
budgetAnalysis.worker: Worker keeps its existing 10000ms cap and remaining CLI cap; public API keeps a separate 10000ms supervisor deadline and invokes no native helper.
budgetAnalysis.cleanup: A terminal failure fixes a single 2000ms cleanup allowance; changing H does not refresh that allowance, authorize retry, or convert unconfirmed cleanup into success.
budgetAnalysis.publication: Before finalization admission, deadline or cancellation prevents rename. After the sole non-cancellable rename has been submitted, actual settlement must be awaited; this existing exception is not bounded by CLI30000. Following observed settlement, one shared 2000ms read-only confirmation/disposition allowance applies. There is no reset, rollback, second rename or success-stdout extension. A late committed namespace is retained and yields OUTPUT21.
budgetAnalysis.stdout: Timely verified publication may transport the exact summary only within the original CLI deadline; output failure after commit retains the namespace.
budgetAnalysis.HOnlyChange: A later separately authorized numeric helper-bound correction alone must not silently alter aggregate, CLI, API, worker, cleanup, cancellation, finalization-admission or post-admission settlement rules.
budgetAnalysis.unresolvedPerformance: These observed traces leave positive helper and CLI slack, but no measured guarantee covers simultaneous slow calls, worst-case worker work, OS contention, or finalization settlement.

retainedLiveBrackets.interpretation: Each observed bracket surrounds actual slot3 sequence work before/after the supervisor interval, but also contains unrelated prior/current snapshot parsing and next-request setup. It is a loose containment interval for that recorded run, not pure sequence time or a future upper bound.
retainedLiveBrackets.noQBound: These brackets and offline calibration measure overlapping work. Do not add them together or convert the maximum into a population or scheduling bound.

unknowns: Actual asynchronous continuation scheduling between transport settlement and sequence.complete in a live CLI.

transfer.rounding: A500ms deterministic grid does not by itself establish coverage of numerically unbounded residual uncertainty; no new admission clock or padding is inferred.

separateEngineeringClock: An authorized20000ms engineering observation guard observes the unchanged helper beyond5000; it is not the product CLI supervisor or an API/worker deadline change.
currentDisposition: Retain30000 CLI admission,10000 API/worker and2000 cleanup. The existing one-rename post-admission settlement exception is not broadened.
